# Summary
:::

Biostatistician and data scientist with 5+ years in clinical, cosmetic, and microbiome R&D. Write statistical analysis plans and analysis methodologies, program them in R, and carry the results through blind review to study reports. Methods cover design of experiments, mixed models, and multivariate and multi-omics analysis, delivered with the engineering that makes them reproducible: Git, tests, CI/CD, containers.
:::
